# Ledger -- live factory state

One line per state change, appended by the `iteration` skill. Evidence is
part of the line. This tracks what is IN FLIGHT -- when the file passes the cap
`docs-budget` sets for it, drop merged features' lines; the commits are the durable record.
Archive a year to `docs/archive/LEDGER-<year>.md` only if you re-read it.

Format: `Fnnn | STATE | round a/b | YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | agent: X | evidence`
